title: Camera me gap, phir bhi edge kaise?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] Camera me bat-ball ke beech GAP...
phir bhi Gill ka review gaya! Kyun?
Stumps ka mic har awaaz pakadta hai.
Ball bat ke paas se guzri... usi frame pe spike!
Matlab pehle bat laga... toh LBW nahi!
Aise aur raaz ke liye... follow karo!
caption:
India vs New Zealand, 1st Test, Wellington (19 Nov 2026): Bumrah ki ball Glenn Phillips ke pad pe lagi, umpire ne NOT OUT diya. India ne DRS liya... front-on camera me bat aur ball ke beech gap dikh raha tha. Phir bhi faisla NOT OUT hi raha, India ka review gaya, aur Shubman Gill umpire se behes karte dikhe. 🏏

Raaz: Snicko (Snickometer). Stumps ke paas laga ek sensitive mic har awaaz pakadta hai. Us awaaz ka graph slow-motion video ke har frame ke saath dikhaya jaata hai. Ball bat ko chhoo le toh ek chhoti, tez "spike" banti hai, aur wo thik usi frame pe honi chahiye jab ball bat ke paas se guzarti hai. Pad ya zameen ki awaaz ka graph zyada flat hota hai. Yahan spike usi pal aayi: third umpire ne halki inside edge maani, phir pad.

Aur cricket ka rule (MCC Law 36): ball pehle bat ko chhoo le, toh LBW out nahi ho sakta. Isliye NOT OUT.

Tumhe kya laga: edge tha ya nahi? Comment karo 👇
